subject: Wire xandesvdot into the CMake march and build.sh d4 target
description: Done: GGML_RV_XANDESVDOT option in ggml/CMakeLists.txt appends _xandesvdot to MARCH_STR; build.sh grew a `d4` target (GGML_CPU_REPACK=ON + GGML_RV_XANDESVDOT=ON, -DQ1_PREFETCH_DIST=1 -DQ1_D4=1) plus build-d4-qemu.sh for the user-mode QEMU correctness build. Codegen verified: 8 nds.vd4dots.vv + 8 vmv.v.x (no vlse32) + 1 prefetch loop in the gemv kernel.
